name: Guilherme Bernardo da Nóbrega
heroSubtitle: I build digital products, internal systems and automations that reduce manual work and scale operations.

aboutMe.intro: I work on the architecture and development of digital products, internal systems and automations focused on operational efficiency, integration and scalability. I operate at the intersection of technology and business, taking technical responsibility for platforms, integrations and infrastructure. My core stack includes Next.js, React, TypeScript, Node.js, PostgreSQL, Supabase and Docker, with complementary use of Python, Rust and mobile stacks according to project needs.

cases.title: MAX PET Fiscal ERP
cases.problem: The operation needed to centralize fiscal routines, POS, inventory and internal processes in a consistent system.
cases.solution: Designed and developed an ERP with automated invoice issuing, inventory control, POS and operational routines.
cases.result: Integrated operational base to reduce manual work, increase fiscal control and improve business management.

cases.title: Altiva Serviços - B2B Service Order Platform
cases.problem: A service order cycle with multiple actors, approvals and evidence needed traceability and control.
cases.solution: B2B platform connecting fleets, repair shops, quotes, digital approvals, execution, invoices, delivery and audit trail.
cases.result: Simplified service workflow with digital approval, audit snapshot and multi-company operation.

cases.title: BeautyLink - Product for Beauty Professionals
cases.problem: Beauty professionals needed an organized digital presence oriented toward conversion.
cases.solution: Architecture, technical leadership and development of a digital product with TypeScript and PostgreSQL.
cases.result: Production product to organize links, digital presence and user journey.

cases.title: PodCriar - Sponsors and Incentivized Projects
cases.problem: Sponsors and approved incentive-law project proponents need a clearer and more traceable way to connect.
cases.solution: Digital platform connecting sponsoring companies to cultural, social and sports projects approved under incentive laws.
cases.result: Product base to connect sponsorship supply and fundraising demand in a digital workflow.

cases.title: Hospital do Olho - Intranet / Identity / Integration
cases.problem: Need to centralize access to multiple internal systems, integrate legacy systems, modernize intranet, implement monitoring trackers and Ombudsman HelpDesk.
cases.solution: Architecture with SSO via OIDC, API integrations between systems, unified portal for all modules.
cases.result: Better governance and access control, increased productivity with reduced rework, standardization of processes and interfaces.

cases.title: E-commerce at Scale (Wicomm)
cases.problem: VTEX/WAKE stores needing complex customizations while maintaining performance.
cases.solution: Custom components, ERP integrations, checkout optimization.
cases.result: 4 stores delivered (AD Fashion, Toy Mania, King & Joe, Ladeira Bijuterias).

cases.title: Process Automation
cases.problem: Repetitive manual processes consuming team time.
cases.solution: Automated workflows for system integration and notifications.
cases.result: Automation of operational flows, time savings on manual tasks.
